title: Distillable tripartite W states from tripartite GHZ states by LOCC
source: Yang and Jeong give bounds on the GHZ entanglement cost of the W state in Section~IV~A. The rate $R_{\mathrm{GHZ}\to\mathrm{W}}$ is the reciprocal of this cost \sourcecite{ref:c5a06d-yj15}{YJ15}.

comment: The rate $1$ shown by Vrana and Christandl concerns stochastic LOCC conditioned on a successful measurement outcome \sourcecite{ref:c5a06d-vc15}{VC15} (Sections II and III).
